title: Simple Mode's wizard on a billable work order reads as before
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure the test location uses Simple Mode.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in status In Progress, billable, with one part that carries a core of $50.00.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Start the completion wizard.
  3. Go to the wizard's last step.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The core step shows the part's $50.00 core.

Step 3:

  • The last step offers "Create invoice".
